findings.decompiled: return 32, 0  |  _1 = stor[0] / owner = 0 / log OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner=address(_1), address indexed newOwner=0)
findings.source: tokenURI: return bytes(baseURI).length > 0 ? ... : ""; Ownable._transferOwnership: address oldOwner = _owner; _owner = newOwner; emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
findings.issue: The empty string is returned as its raw ABI words (32, 0), and the previous owner is read as the whole slot stor[0] instead of owner, the variable declared at that slot.
findings.rule: Return of the ABI words (32, 0) is return ''; a whole-slot read of a slot holding only an address variable, used through address(.), is that variable.

notes: The only source loop reached, Strings.toString's while (true) under tokenURI, is not in the bytecode: _baseURI() returns the constant empty string, so the compiler removed the toString branch; it is therefore not counted (Math.log10 is loop-free). No while in the text. All functions (ERC721 approve/transfer/safeTransfer with the onERC721Received check, mint, Ownable) read line by line against OpenZeppelin 4.8.
summary: A small, faithful ERC721 text; the only source loop was removed by the compiler, and only cosmetic issues (raw empty-string return, a whole-slot owner read) remain.
